description: Plan A (Apple HIG 5 Lenses + Native Code Audit) is the default baseline. Plan C defect cases are registered here when real visual, spatial, or interaction-layering defects are encountered in practice.

active_cases.title: Duplicate Same-Source Data Representation (Donut Legend + Redundant Category Progress Bars)
active_cases.symptom: Rendering a Donut/Ring chart with a full category breakdown legend AND immediately stacking a second category progress-bar list bound to the exact same dataset in the same pane.
active_cases.fix_rule: Never render the same dataset twice in one viewport; fuse the chart with a compact 2-column Bento legend grid (tap tile -> filter detail list) OR use a Segmented Picker to toggle between Chart and Progress List.

active_cases.title: Unbounded Horizontal HStack/ForEach Overflow & Multi-Card Row Cramming on Compact Width
active_cases.symptom: Unbounded HStack { ForEach(...) } without ScrollView(.horizontal) or cramming 3+ multi-button interactive cards into a single compact HStack expands the parent VStack beyond the iPhone viewport width (393pt), clipping sibling headers and cards on both left and right edges.
active_cases.fix_rule: Wrap dynamic horizontal rails in ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false), scope per-item progress rails to the active parent item, cap complex interactive cards at <= 2 per horizontal row on compact width (use 2 + 1 grid for unilateral L + R + Reps), and apply .containerRelativeFrame(.horizontal) on vertical ScrollView content roots.

active_cases.title: LazyStack Leaf Conditional Subview Leak & OnAppear Prefetch Invalidation (WWDC26-321)
active_cases.symptom: Placing a top-level 'if' inside LazyVStack/LazyHStack ForEach closures creates dynamic 0/1 subview counts per element, defeating frame-deadline prefetching and retaining offscreen views in memory; delaying @Observable/@State model allocation to .onAppear misses the pre-render prefetch window.
active_cases.fix_rule: Filter data in the collection or @Query(#Predicate) before ForEach so each item resolves 1:1 to a single root view; initialize lightweight @State/@Observable view models in init (paired with @Observable Macro lazy property tracking) and use .onScrollTargetVisibilityChange(idType:threshold:) for media visibility.

active_cases.title: Hallmark Floor: Tracked-Capital Eyebrow & Oversized Letter Labels
active_cases.symptom: Placing small uppercase tracked-capital eyebrow labels above every heading or decorative oversized letter labels makes Web pages read immediately as machine-generated AI slop.
active_cases.fix_rule: Omit decorative eyebrows above headings; render labels, captions, table headers, tags, and nav links in the body/label face one step smaller, sentence or lowercase, untracked (letter-spacing <= 0.04em).

active_cases.title: Hallmark Floor: Non-Functional Fake Submit Form & Dead Action Control
active_cases.symptom: Shipping a decorative form (such as a footer email band or contact box) that intercepts submit with preventDefault() to show a fake 'Thanks!' state without sending or persisting data.
active_cases.fix_rule: Every shipped form must wire to a real submission endpoint/handler with 8 interactive states; if no backend exists yet, replace the fake form with a real action link (mailto:, GitHub issue, RSS) or explicit slot.

active_cases.title: Fabricated .glassEffect(.prominent) & Post-Glass Layout Modifier Order Bug
active_cases.symptom: Hallucinating non-existent .glassEffect(.prominent) or applying padding/frame after .glassEffect(), corrupting lens curvature and hit-target bounds.
active_cases.fix_rule: Use only .regular, .clear, or .identity inside .glassEffect(); use .buttonStyle(.glassProminent) for emphasis, group adjacent controls in GlassEffectContainer, and apply padding/frame/font before glassEffect.

active_cases.title: Nested Button-in-Button Label Collapse, Locked-minHeight Expandable Drawer & Page Snapshot fixedSize Tight-Crop
active_cases.symptom: Nesting interactive child Button controls inside an outer Button label (.buttonStyle(.plain)), locking an expandable drawer row (if expanded) to a collapsed outer minHeight without height isolation, or applying .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true) to a page-level snapshot host collapses AppKit/SwiftUI row intrinsic height (causing vertical text/row overlap) and tight-crops full-window snapshots to hide bottom dead space.
active_cases.fix_rule: Never nest Button controls inside another Button label; isolate the row selection trigger from expanded action buttons in a VStack/HStack container with adaptive height, and render page-level snapshots at full viewport dimensions (1280x800 desktop / 390x844 mobile) without .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true).

active_cases.title: Multi-Boolean .sheet(isPresented:) State Collision & Custom Material Bottom Bar
active_cases.symptom: Stacking multiple boolean .sheet(isPresented:) modifiers or hand-rolling an ultraThinMaterial bottom tab bar instead of native TabView/sidebarAdaptable.
active_cases.fix_rule: Consolidate modal presentations into one Identifiable enum bound to one .sheet(item:) modifier and use native TabView with .tabViewStyle(.sidebarAdaptable).

active_cases.title: Self-Proving Instructional Micro-Copy Clutter & OCR Spec-Prose Leak on UI Surface
active_cases.symptom: Printing interaction specifications or tutorial micro-copy directly onto the UI canvas (e.g., Text("点击任务置顶聚焦 · 标题与属性展示处直接点按修改"), Label("执行步骤树", ...), Text("点按文字原地修改 · 右下麦克风语音直补"), Text("按住右下麦克风继续追补"), Text("点按任意条目切换至顶部聚焦")) to self-certify that direct manipulation exists for static screenshot or Vision OCR checks.
active_cases.fix_rule: Never print interaction rules or tutorial micro-copy onto the UI surface to pass OCR or screenshot reviews; enforce Self-Evident Affordance over Instructional Micro-Copy (UI_INSTRUCTIONAL_CLUTTER gate) and verify interactive state transitions via Before/After state-diff screenshots or XCTest/Playwright interactive assertions.
active_cases.forbidden_regex:
(?:Text|Label)\s*\(\s*"[^
"]*(?:(?:点击|点按|长按|按住|双击)[^
"'<>]{0,20}?(?:即可|直接|原地|可|继续)?[^
"'<>]{0,8}?(?:修改|编辑|切换|展开|收起|聚焦|置顶|追补|直补|录入|补充)|操作\s*/\s*展示一体|执行步骤树|点击任务置顶聚焦|标题与属性展示处直接点按修改|点按文字原地修改|右下麦克风语音直补|按住右下麦克风继续追补|点按任意条目切换至顶部聚焦)[^
"]*"

active_cases.title: Top-Stacked Duplicate Focus Card Substituted for In-Place List Unfold & Unstripped Subtractive Dock Chrome
active_cases.symptom: When the Owner mandates 'tap item to unfold detail in-place' and 'only keep 2 bottom buttons', Steering/Writer substitutes a top-stacked focus card (IOSTopFocusTodoCard + Text("其余待办") divider above companionTodos) for true in-place list row expansion, and clones RecorderDock's 148pt background mask, waveform bars, and feedback banner because design.md lacked Negative DOM/View Assertions (count == 0) and a concrete Obsolete Test Manifest.
active_cases.fix_rule: Never substitute a top-stacked duplicate/hero card + '其余待办' split list when the Owner asks for in-place card expansion: unfold the tapped card container directly at its position in the single ForEach list. Every subtractive mandate ('只保留/去掉/砍掉') in design.md/spec.md must declare explicit Negative DOM/View Assertions (count == 0 / !exists) and a concrete file:line Obsolete Test Manifest.

active_cases.title: Expand-State Pill Label/Height Pop-In, Header-Interleaved Insertion & Unclipped Panel Overlap
active_cases.symptom: Switching persistent status/priority pills between icon-only (showLabel: false) when collapsed and icon+text (showLabel: true / isExpanded) when expanded or toggling minHeight: isExpanded ? 28 : 22 causes abrupt text/size pop-in; inserting if isExpanded blocks between unifiedTitleHeaderRow and unifiedMetadataStatusPriorityTimestampRow pushes the persistent status row down with a jump; and applying .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .move(edge: .top))) to inline tag panels slides them out from behind upper sibling views with overlap.
active_cases.fix_rule: Keep persistent status and priority pills identical in label, font, and height across collapsed and expanded states (UI_EXPAND_STATE_MUTATION); keep persistent header rows contiguous and place all expand-only sections below them (UI_HEADER_INTERLEAVED_INSERTION); and wrap expand-only sections and inline drawers in a continuous height-interpolating Layout + .clipped() rather than .transition(.move(edge: .top)) (UI_UNCLIPPED_PANEL_OVERLAP).

active_cases.title: Xcode Preview Host ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB=YES Missing (preview-host-enable-debug-dylib) & Compact Pill Visual-vs-Hit-Area Inflation
active_cases.symptom: A SwiftPM package defines an executable *PreviewHost alongside #Preview in Package.swift without ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB = YES across project.yml / *.xcodeproj targets (causing Xcode #Preview to fail with ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB), or paints a full 44x44pt mobile or 28x28pt desktop hit frame as a solid badge or citation pill, inflating the visible control.
active_cases.fix_rule: When a SwiftPM package defines an executable *PreviewHost alongside #Preview, generate a native .xcodeproj (project.yml + xcodegen) with ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB = YES on both the executable host and library target (plus shared schemes) and open .xcodeproj in Xcode so #Preview never fails with ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB; keep the tinted visual capsule compact at roughly 20-24pt inside a transparent outer hit target sized for accessibility.

active_cases.title: Floating Chrome & Scroll Safe-Area Collision
active_cases.symptom: Scrollable content intersects floating bottom bars or top status chrome because the final item and scrolled text have no safe-area clearance.
active_cases.fix_rule: Reserve bottom contentMargins so the final item clears the floating dock with zero intersection, and soften or protect top scrolled text from status-bar chrome.

active_cases.title: Stacked Metadata Leading-Rail & Multi-Line Header Alignment
active_cases.symptom: Vertical icon-and-label metadata rows drift across text rails, while multi-line table headers lack a shared baseline or consistent column geometry.
active_cases.fix_rule: Use a fixed-width icon slot for one text rail and align multi-line headers to a shared baseline with stable column geometry.

active_cases.title: Custom Theme Engine & Manual .designTheme / Theme(isDark:) View-Tree Plumbing
active_cases.symptom: App views wire a custom theme state machine or manual per-root/per-sheet appearance injection (.designTheme(...) or .environment(\.theme, Theme(isDark: ...))) or ship an app-private light/dark toggle instead of tracking native OS appearance automatically.
active_cases.fix_rule: Track native OS light/dark appearance automatically via dynamic semantic tokens (VS-*/CL-*); remove custom in-app theme switchers, .designTheme(...) modifiers, and .environment(\.theme, Theme(isDark: ...)) plumbing (UI_CUSTOM_THEME_PLUMBING).

archived_templates.title: Static HTML Raw YAML Frontmatter Leak Above Doctype
archived_templates.symptom: Static .html files served with .nojekyll or direct HTTP start with --- layout: null ... --- YAML frontmatter, rendering raw metadata text across the top of the browser viewport.
archived_templates.fix_rule: Every static HTML entry file must start with <!doctype html> on line 1; handle routing via directory structure (/route/index.html) rather than Jekyll frontmatter.

archived_templates.title: macOS Fixed-Width NSPopover Frame-Before-Padding Clipping
archived_templates.symptom: Applying .frame(width: W).padding(P) inside NSPopover expands intrinsic content width to W+2P and clips trailing controls.
archived_templates.fix_rule: Apply .padding(P).frame(width: W) and verify pixelWidth == W * scale.

archived_templates.title: Dynamic Telemetry Readout Numeric Ellipsis (12…)
archived_templates.symptom: High-precision metrics truncate with ellipsis when paired with long labels.
archived_templates.fix_rule: Apply .monospacedDigit() and .layoutPriority(1) on numeric readouts; use ViewThatFits for unbounded titles.

archived_cases.title: Single-Plane Flat Tiling & ShipSwift Spatial Signature Loss (SWWallet Flattened to VStack/ForEach)
archived_cases.symptom: Agent treats the appearance-ledger component palette as a mandatory flat checklist, stacking 4+ sections (Hero + Donut + Duplicate Category Bars + Flattened Wallet List + Transactions) in one >1000pt ScrollView, and rewrites ShipSwift SWWallet from a ZStack 3D pocket stack into a flat VStack/ForEach list.
archived_cases.fix_rule: Apply the 3-Axis × P0..P3 Priority Matrix (Display / Action / Display+Action): cap any single viewport or split-view pane at 2-3 visual groups, collapse non-active groups (Accordion / Segmented Lens / Sheet), merge reference hints into placeholders/subtitles, and preserve ShipSwift SWWallet ZStack + zIndex + offset(y:) pocket geometry.

archived_cases.title: Table Header-to-Cell Column Geometry Drift (Flex Header vs. Fixed-Width Centered Row)
archived_cases.symptom: Table header HStack uses maxWidth: .infinity + .leading on a column while the corresponding data row HStack uses only fixed width + .center columns, causing the row HStack to be narrower than the container, center-drift inside the card, and misalign every cell beneath its header.
archived_cases.fix_rule: Enforce a shared column geometry contract between Header and Row (identical fixed column widths, identical maxWidth: .infinity flex columns, identical per-column alignment, and 100% matching outer HStack spacing/padding, or use SwiftUI Grid / GridRow); never pair a maxWidth: .infinity header column with fixed-width-only data rows.

archived_cases.title: Web Prose Decorative Emoji Heading & Box-in-Box Callout Clutter
archived_cases.symptom: Long-form Web prose prefixes section headings with decorative Emojis (📌/❓/✅/🎬/🏷️) and wraps every Q&A or checklist in its own bordered card, creating wireframe clutter.
archived_cases.fix_rule: Use quiet editorial typography: native blockquote (4px left accent bar) for TL;DR, standard h2/h3 + 1px hairline dividers for Q&A/checklists, zero nested .card cages inside .prose, and zero decorative heading Emojis.

archived_cases.title: Web Prose Table Global white-space:nowrap Horizontal Overflow
archived_cases.symptom: Applying white-space: nowrap to all .prose th, .prose td forces multi-column CJK prose tables onto single lines, overflowing 680px desktop cards and clipping 390px mobile viewports.
archived_cases.fix_rule: Allow natural text wrapping on .prose td (white-space: normal; min-width: 96px) inside an overflow-x: auto table container, and restrict white-space: nowrap to .num, time, or short code columns.
archived_cases.good_snippet:
.prose th { white-space: nowrap; }
.prose td { padding: 8px 10px; white-space: normal; min-width: 96px; }
